price_assumption.version: Browser Use V4 published rates checked 2026-11-01; existing accounts may have different legacy terms

lifetime_definition: Local Chromium Popen start through first saved terminal owned-browser close, preferring browser_cleanup_before_judge. Repeated final-close receipt is not used when first-close receipt exists. Includes setup, actor work, final capture and teardown before judge. Legacy terminal-root-only proof is distinct from newer full owned-group verification.
scope_note: Exact recorded task dispositions only. Excludes startup probes and unselected/abandoned historical attempts; not full historical campaign all-attempt billing. No cloud runtime, throughput, network-traffic or billing equivalence is assumed. Missing duration is not zero. Actor-latency proxy is separate, never mixed into owned-browser means.
